records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Systems
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Account is engaged and positive (email:b9e28f20), reached first project day 1 (first_project 2026-06-22), 8 days left. But no teammate invited, no key milestone in 6 days, and the customer deferred a walkthrough ("at some point"), suggesting low urgency after initial setup.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Glad to hear the first week is going well — and good to know a walkthrough could be useful. Happy to do a short call this week whenever suits you; just name a time and I'll work around it.

If it's easier, I can also point you to the next step inside your project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually where things start to click. And whenever you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Best,
Chidi
